name: WooCommerce
description: Connect your WooCommerce store so the agent can find a customer's orders, track shipments, cancel or re-route undispatched orders, issue refunds, and answer product and stock questions.

woocommerce_get_store.label: Get Store Info
woocommerce_get_store.description: Get basic information about the connected store (URL, currency, versions).

woocommerce_find_customer.label: Find Customer
woocommerce_find_customer.description: Find a customer by email or phone (accounts and guest checkouts), with their most recent orders.

woocommerce_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
woocommerce_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders by email, most recent first.

woocommerce_get_order.label: Get Order
woocommerce_get_order.description: Get an order by id or number: items, totals, addresses, refunds, tracking and support eligibility.

woocommerce_get_order_tracking.label: Get Order Tracking
woocommerce_get_order_tracking.description: Get an order's shipment tracking from the store's tracking plugin or order data.

woocommerce_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
woocommerce_cancel_order.description: Cancel an order that has not been dispatched (pending, on-hold or processing, with no tracking recorded).

woocommerce_create_refund.label: Create Refund
woocommerce_create_refund.description: Refund an order in full, by item, or by amount, capped at the remaining refundable balance.

woocommerce_update_order_shipping_addres.label: Update Order Shipping Address
woocommerce_update_order_shipping_addres.description: Change where an undispatched order will ship. Refuses once tracking is recorded or the order is completed.

woocommerce_add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
woocommerce_add_order_note.description: Add an internal note to an order, optionally sent to the customer.

woocommerce_search_products.label: Search Products
woocommerce_search_products.description: Search published products by name or description.

woocommerce_get_product.label: Get Product
woocommerce_get_product.description: Get a product with price, stock and its variations.

woocommerce_check_inventory.label: Check Inventory
woocommerce_check_inventory.description: Check stock status and quantity for a product or variation SKU.

consumerKey.label: Consumer Key
consumerKey.description: WooCommerce REST API Consumer Key (WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API, Read/Write)
